PROCEDURE CODE
1151
Seals are also affixed either ex officio or at the request of the public prosecutor, the burgomaster or an alderman: 
(1¡ if any of the persons concerned are incapable and without legal representation, and the seals are not requested by a relative.)
2¡ if the spouse, the heirs or one of them is (presumed absent) or is not present;
3¡ if the deceased was a public depositary, in which case the seals will be affixed only by reason of that deposit and on the objects comprising it.
